rule.description: User Account Entitlement change (Do Nothing Option)
rule.comment: The User Account Entitlement grants the user an enabled account in Remedy. Revoking the entitlement will delete the Remedy account, do nothing or set the status depending on the value you select for the 'When account entitlement revoked' global variable. This rule executes when the entitlement is changing and you have selected the disable option.
